Velocity at mean position, v = A

Match List I with List II.

List I List II
(a) Isothermal (i) Pressure constant
(b) Isochoric (ii) Temperature constant
(c) Adiabatic (iii) Volume constant
(d) Isobaric (iv) Heat content is constant

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
en.explanation:
We know that, in isothermal process, T = 0

In isochoric process, V = 0

In adiabatic process, Q = 0

In isobaric process, p = 0

So, the correct match is,

A 2, B 3, C 4, D 1
